about: WoW clients the add-on installs into and starts. WoW Forever lives in _classic_beta_ (WowB.exe, add-on Interface 16001). Started through the Battle.net app with --exec=launch <family> so it signs in by itself; WowB.exe directly (own login screen) when Battle.net isn't installed or doesn't start it. Verified on this PC 2026-10-12: 'launch WoWF' runs WowB.exe -launcherlogin -uid wow_classic_beta within a second ('launch WoW' picks retail; launch_uid only selects).
